description: This Java class 'ResponseActionExamples' provides various example methods demonstrating how to configure responses in MockServer, including setting response bodies, headers, cookies, status codes, delays, connection options, and templated responses using different template engines.

classes.name: ResponseActionExamples
classes.description: A class containing example methods demonstrating various response configurations in MockServer.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithBodyOnly
methods.description: Responds with a simple body string for any request.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithUTF16BodyResponse
methods.description: Responds with a UTF-16 encoded string and sets Content-Type header accordingly.

methods.name: jsonResponseWithUTF8Body
methods.description: Responds with a JSON body containing a Farsi string with UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: invalidJsonResponseBody
methods.description: Responds with an invalid JSON body to demonstrate error handling.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithHeader
methods.description: Responds with a body and a custom header.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithCookie
methods.description: Responds with a body, header, and a cookie.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithStatusCodeAndReasonPhraseOnly
methods.description: Responds with a specific status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: respondDifferentlyForTheSameRequest
methods.description: Configures different responses for the same request based on call count.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithBinaryPNGBody
methods.description: Responds with binary PNG data loaded from a resource, with headers.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithConnectionOptionsToSuppressHeaders
methods.description: Responds with connection options to suppress certain headers.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithConnectionOptionsToOverrideHeaders
methods.description: Responds with connection options to override headers.

methods.name: responseLiteralWithConnectionOptionsToCloseSocket
methods.description: Responds with connection options to close the socket.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedResponse
methods.description: Responds with a JavaScript template that dynamically generates response data based on request headers and body.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedResponseWithDelay
methods.description: Responds with a JavaScript template and a delay of 2 minutes.

methods.name: velocityTemplatedResponse
methods.description: Responds with a Velocity template that uses request headers and body.

methods.name: mustacheTemplatedResponse
methods.description: Responds with a Mustache template that uses request headers and body.
